scheme_name: Assistance for Tools, Equipment, Shorting/Grading Equipment, PHM Equipment for Scheduled Tribes (HRT-3)
other_conditions: Tool/equipment must be purchased from an authorised dealer of the empanelled manufacturer as notified by the Department of Agriculture.
Companies empanelled for tarpaulin seats must comply with the Department of Agriculture norms.
Companies empanelled for plastic crates must comply with the Department of Agriculture norms.
Both individual farmers and farmer groups/cooperative societies are eligible.
benefits_summary: Individual Scheduled Tribe farmers receive up to 75% of tool/equipment cost (capped at ₹3,750), while farmer groups/cooperative societies receive up to 90% (capped at ₹7,50,000) for PHM equipment.
